item.title: Distros — Rocky Linux 10
item.description: If you want the RHEL 10 userland on RISC-V without touching a Red Hat account: Rocky 10.3 (GA 2026-11-16) now ships installation ISOs, a generic SBC raw image, cloud images and a riscv64 package repository (952 packages in BaseOS); QEMU and VisionFive 2 are officially supported at release, and the P550 is under limited support. ｜ Based on RHEL 10 (CentOS Stream 10 code base)
